From: Saanvi Rao <saanvi@neuralmesh.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:02:14-04:00
Subject: Request to redeem expired onboarding credits and resume paused sandbox

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this. We finished an initial eval with Redwood earlier this quarter but our sandbox ran out mid-test last week and our account shows the "Onboarding credits expired" state. We're an early-stage team (NeuralMesh) and the UI suggests we used our trial allotment back in July — we didn't realize the billing link would prevent the sandbox from being reactivated automatically.

Quick context: we were running a 20k-token/day load for a 3-model pipeline. The paused access is blocking a customer demo scheduled for next Tuesday (9/22). Can your team help with either redeeming the expired promotional credits or granting a short-term top-up so we can get the demo back on track?

Account / HubSpot ref: NDL-4532
Requested help: 1) one-week sandbox reactivation OR 2) temporary token top-up ~50k tokens + 30-day window

I've attached a screenshot of the console status (screenshot-account-status.png). Happy to share any additional info.

Thanks,
Saanvi Rao
Head of Product
NeuralMesh

Date: 2026-09-19T10:27:05-04:00
Subject: Re: Request to redeem expired onboarding credits and resume paused sandbox

Hi Saanvi — thanks for the note and the screenshot. Sorry this slipped through; I can escalate for a one-off fix. A couple quick clarifying questions so we move fast:

- Can you confirm the account email used to sign up (looks like team@neuralmesh.ai?)
- Would the 50k tokens + 30-day window be enough for the demo and immediate follow-ups?

I'll loop in Ben for approval to make an exception for a short-term top-up. If approved, we usually ask for a signed reactivation acknowledgement (simple form) to track the promo exception — attaching the short form now: reactivation-form.docx.

If you can confirm the signup email and that the token amount covers your demo, I'll push this to operations and try to get the sandbox live today/tomorrow.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182
